modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On October 31, 1973: Three Provisional Irish Republican Army members escaped from Mountjoy Prison in Dublin aboard a hijacked helicopter that landed in the prison's exercise yard.
On October 31, 2000: Soyuz TM-31 launches, carrying the first resident crew to the International Space Station. The ISS has been crewed continuously since then.
On October 31, 1923: The first of 160 consecutive days of 100° Fahrenheit at Marble Bar, Western Australia.
On October 31, 1913: Dedication of the Lincoln Highway, the first automobile highway across United States.
On October 31, 1956: Hungarian Revolution of 1956: A Revolutionary Headquarters is established in Hungary.
